label: y=1 wrong, y=0 correct; abstain/ambiguous excluded; DEGENERATE=wrong

R_residualization.regressor_primary: SplineTransformer(n_knots=5, degree=3) per confound + RidgeCV(alphas=[0.1,1,10]); cross-fitted
R_residualization.regressor_secondary: OLS linear on the same confounds; cross-fitted
R_residualization.stratified_check: AUROC within quintiles of log_odds (quintiles from all P1 rows, label-blind)
R_residualization.rule: CI inside [0.45,0.55] means residual_null_equivalent; CI lower > 0.55 means residual_signal_present; CI excluding 0.5 but within the margin means tiny_residual_below_margin; otherwise inconclusive.

C_causal_vocab.prompts: P1 matched PopQA prompts (wrong+correct) and abstain rows, canonical inputs
interventions: learned_diff at l* with alpha in {0.25,0.5,1.0}
E1 dom direction at (11,suf-4), norm-matched to ||r||, alpha=1.0
C_causal_vocab.measure: mean delta log-softmax over vocab at last position; rank of Unknown set

A_amnesic.probe: E1 nested logistic at suf-4 with layer fixed = 11 (no selection)
A_amnesic.metric: OOF AUROC before vs after removal, P1
